class.name: AccessibilityColorScheme
class.brief_description: The colors of an accessibility color scheme for the GUI.
class.description: A color scheme that [AccessibilitySettingsServer] turns into an overlay theme for the root window: [member text_color] and [member field_text_color] for the font colors, [member selection_color] for selections, [member surface_color] and [member border_color] for panels and normal buttons, [member accent_color] and [member accent_border_color] for hovered, pressed and selected states, [member focus_color] for the focus outline, [member border_width] for all borders. [member ok_color], [member problem_color] and [member caution_color] are for the game: read them with [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.get_scheme_color]. Two schemes are built in ([method create_high_contrast_dark], [method create_high_contrast_light]). For an own scheme, save an [AccessibilityColorScheme] as a [code].tres[/code] file and set its path with [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.set_custom_color_scheme_path] and [constant AccessibilitySettingsServer.COLOR_SCHEME_CUSTOM]. The default values are the dark high-contrast scheme.

method.name: create_high_contrast_dark
method.description: Returns a new scheme with white text on black surfaces, white borders, a yellow focus outline and 2 pixel borders.

method.name: create_high_contrast_light
method.description: Returns a new scheme with black text on white surfaces, black borders, a blue focus outline and 2 pixel borders.

method.name: get_role_color
method.description: Returns the color of [param role]: [code]text[/code], [code]field_text[/code], [code]ok[/code], [code]problem[/code], [code]caution[/code], [code]selection[/code], [code]focus[/code], [code]surface[/code], [code]accent[/code], [code]border[/code] or [code]accent_border[/code] (the property name without [code]_color[/code]). Returns [param default] for any other role.

members.member: The border color of hovered, pressed and selected controls.
The background of hovered, pressed and selected controls, and of progress bar fills and slider grabber areas.
The border color of panels, fields and normal buttons. Disabled controls use it with half the alpha.
The border width of all flat style boxes, in pixels (0 to 16). The focus outline is at least 2 pixels wide.
The color for warnings, for the game.
The font color of text fields ([LineEdit], [TextEdit], [CodeEdit]).
The color of the focus outline.
The color for success, for the game.
The color for errors and danger, for the game.
The background of panels, fields and normal buttons.
The font color of all built-in controls except text fields. Disabled and placeholder text use it with 60% of its alpha.
